_doc: Sound effects. Files are generated by tools/sfxgen into assets/sfx/<file>.ogg (see docs/11-music.md, 'Sound effects'). Each event names one or more variant files (one is picked at random, never the same twice in a row), a gain (0..1, before the player's Sound effects volume), cooldown_s (real seconds: a repeat sooner than this is dropped, so fast-forward never machine-guns), max_playing (copies of this event sounding at once), pitch_var and gain_var (random +- spread per play, presentation only) and positional (played at a place in the city: heard only on or near the screen, quieter and panned off-centre). What triggers each event is described in the doc.

positional._doc: Distances are in half-screens from the centre of the view: 1 = the edge of the screen. Full gain inside 'full', falling to 'far_gain' at 'max', silent beyond. 'pan' is the stereo spread at the screen edge.

ambient._doc: A quiet looping city bed. Its level follows the people living and working in the buildings on screen: silent below people_min, full at people_full. fade_s smooths changes.
